research_status: COMPLETE — all 13 episodes of Rosario + Vampire Season 1 classified canon/filler/mixed, though with lower confidence than most of this project's shows. Only one directly-fetched source (QuoteTheAnime) provides a full episode-by-episode breakdown: episode 4 is pure filler, episodes 1/7/11/12/13 are mixed (blending manga content with anime-original 'monster of the week' material), and the remaining 7 episodes are manga canon. A general aggregate search independently confirms the overall scale (11 non-canon episodes across both 13-episode seasons combined, ~42%) but no second source with a matching per-episode table was found — flagged on each affected episode's own status_note. No episode titles included — handled automatically by load_episodes.py's auto-backfill (#103). Complete, gap-free coverage of 1-13 confirmed before writing this file.
